;Arts and culture
*[[Prime Minister of India|Indian Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] begins the groundwork of the [[Ram Mandir, Ayodhya|Lord Ram temple]] at the [[Ayodhya dispute|disputed site]] in [[Ayodhya]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], which was the former location of the demolished [[Babri Masjid]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/indian-pm-modi-lays-foundation-ram-temple-razed-mosque-site-200805090217486.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
***The [[Economy of Indonesia|Indonesian economy]] contracts 5.32% in second quarter of 2020, amidst the COVID-19 pandemic. It is the worst economic contraction in the country since the first quarter of 1999. [https://money.kompas.com/read/2020/08/05/131031826/pertumbuhan-ekonomi-ri-minus-532-persen-terendah-sejak-1999?page=all (''Kompas'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Beirut explosions]]
**The death toll from the explosions in the [[Port of Beirut]] rises to 135 people, with more than 5,000 injured and dozens still missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/lebanon-eyes-state-emergency-deadly-beirut-blast-live-200804234925493.html (Al Jazeera)]
**In response to the explosions, the [[Special Tribunal for Lebanon]] delays the pronouncement of the verdict in the criminal case concerning the [[Assassination of Rafic Hariri|assassination]] of former [[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Prime Minister]] [[Rafic Hariri]] from August 7 to August 18. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-tribunal-hariri/lebanon-tribunal-postpones-verdict-in-hariri-case-to-august-18-idUSKCN2512IC?il=0 (Reuters)]
**Several Beirut port officials are placed under [[house arrest]] as an investigation starts into how 2,750 tons of [[ammonium nitrate]] was left unsecured at a warehouse at the port for six years. [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-08-05/beirut-blast-lebanon-in-mourning-as-at-least-100-killed-and-4000-injured-by-explosion (ITV)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record high of 1,271 new COVID-19 cases and 24 deaths in the last 24 hours, according to statement from National Security and Defense Council. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/08/05/world/asia/05reuters-health-coronavirus-ukraine.html?searchResultPosition=7 (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports 1,772 new cases of COVID-19 infection in the last 24 hours, which is the highest number since nationwide [[state of emergency]] was lifted in June. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/08/05/world/europe/05reuters-health-coronavirus-spain-data.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports 1,695 new cases in the last 24 hours, which is the highest number since the end of May. The seven-day moving average stood above the 1,300 threshold for the first time since the end of April. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-france-casualties/frances-new-covid-19-cases-up-1695-a-more-than-two-month-high-idUSKCN2512PL (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Queensland]] declares all of [[New South Wales]] and [[Australian Capital Territory]] to be COVID-19 hotspots and will close its border with both regions on Saturday August 8 at 1 a.m. ([[Time in Australia|AEST]]). [https://www.9news.com.au/national/queensland-coronavirus-premier-shuts-borders-to-nsw-act-covid19-hotspots-annastacia-palaszczuk/8718d41e-7320-4256-bb14-7cebfcf325ef (9 News)]
***[[Victoria (state)|Victoria]] reports 725 new COVID-19 cases and 15 deaths in the last 24 hours. It is the highest number of reported cases and the deadliest day since the pandemic started in the state itself and Australia in general. [https://www.theage.com.au/national/victoria/worst-day-victoria-records-725-new-cases-of-coronavirus-15-deaths-20200805-p55ip4.html (''The Age'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
***[[Aichi Prefecture]] declares its own [[state of emergency]] after the number of COVID-19 cases tops 100 after nine consecutive days. The state of emergency will be enforced for 19 days until August 24. [http://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/13612884 (''The Asahi Shimbun'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in United States]]
***[[Twitter]] restricts President [[Donald Trump]]'s campaign from tweeting after its account shared a video of Trump's interview with [[Fox News]] in which he said children are "almost immune" to [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/08/05/tech/twitter-trump-restrict/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**[[Iran]] executes a man for killing a member of the [[Revolutionary Guards]] during [[2017–2018 Iranian protests|anti-government unrest]] in 2017. His execution was carried out as a retribution sentence demanded by the victim's family. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-unrest-execution/iran-executes-man-convicted-for-killing-guards-soldier-in-2017-unrest-idUSKCN25119W (Reuters)]
*Former [[Guatemala]]n Economic Minister [[Acisclo Valladares Urruela]] is charged by American prosecutors for laundering [[United States dollar|US$]]10 million on behalf of drug traffickers, and using the profits to bribe officials back home. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-guatemala/former-guatemalan-minister-charged-in-u-s-with-laundering-10-million-idUSKCN25138G?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Zhang Yuhuan]] is acquitted of murdering two boys in October 1993 and freed after serving 27 years in prison in [[Jiangxi]] as [[China]]'s longest-serving wrongfully convicted inmate. The killer of the boys remains unknown. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-53666557 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Sri Lankan parliamentary election]]
**[[Sri Lanka]] holds [[Elections in Sri Lanka|parliamentary elections]] after the [[Parliament of Sri Lanka|parliament]] was dissolved by [[President of Sri Lanka|president]] [[Gotabaya Rajapaksa]] in March. Originally scheduled to be held in April, the election was postponed twice due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/aug/05/sri-lanka-election-vote-coronavirus-rajapaksa (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Croatia–Serbia relations]]
**[[Croatia]] marks the 25th [[Victory Day (Croatia)|anniversary]] of [[Operation Storm]], a military victory against the [[proto-state]] of [[Republic of Serbian Krajina|Serbian Krajina]] that ended the [[Croatian War of Independence]]. The ceremony in the town of [[Knin]], former capital of Serbian Krajina, was for the first time ever attended by an ethnic [[Serbs of Croatia|Serb]] political representative, [[Deputy Prime Minister of Croatia|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Boris Milošević]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/croatia-marks-25-years-war-tolerance-message-200805085400673.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Taiwan–United States relations]], [[China–United States relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of Health and Human Services]] [[Alex Azar]] travels to [[Taiwan]] for a multi-day official visit. He is the highest-ranking [[United States|U.S.]] official to visit the country in 40 years after the U.S. stopped recognising Taiwan in 1979 and has had unofficial ties since then. The [[China|PRC]], which claims Taiwan as a breakaway province, condemns the visit. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-usa/u-s-health-chief-to-be-highest-ranking-official-in-decades-to-visit-taiwan-angering-china-idUSKCN25105B?feedType=mktg&feedName=healthNews&WT.mc_id=Partner-Google (Reuters)]
*[[Vanuatu]]'s former prime minister, [[Charlot Salwai]], is referred to the Supreme Court to stand trial for alleged corruption. His lawyer says he is confident they will win the case. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/422849/former-vanuatu-pm-confident-of-beating-corruption-charges (RNZ)]

;Science and technology
*[[Artemis program]]
**[[SpaceX Starship]] prototype ''SN5'' successfully carries out a {{convert|150|m|ft|adj=on|sp=us}} flight test at the [[SpaceX South Texas Launch Site]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-53659702 (BBC News)]
*[[Google]] shuts down 2,500 channels on its video sharing platform [[YouTube]] that were linked to [[China|Chinese]] [[disinformation]]. The channels generally posted "spammy, non-political content", but a small subset touched on politics, the company said. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyber-google-disinformation/google-pulls-2500-china-linked-youtube-channels-over-disinformation-idUSKCN251384?il=0 (Reuters)]
